items.crucible: gas-tight sealed tantalum crucibles (diameter: 6 ram, height: 15 ram)
items.quote: Great care has to be taken in protecting samples in the cell: alloys (-500 mg) were placed in gas-tight sealed tantalum crucibles (diameter: 6 ram, height: 15 ram), and all experiments were performed under purified argon flow. In the temperature range 373 to 773 K, the Cpmeasurements were carried out step by step every 10 Kwith a constant temperature plateau of ~400 s. The heating rate between two plateaus is 3 K/min. Temperatures were determined at • K, and molar heat capacities were measured with an accuracy of -2%.
